error-handler.name: global-error-handler
error-handler.doc:description: Turns any error into the standard error body and status

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Any error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Builds the standard error response and propagates it to the listener

choice.doc:name: Response already built?
choice.doc:description: Skips work when a nested flow already handled this error

when.doc:name: Not yet handled
when.doc:description: First handler on the error path

ee:transform.doc:name: Build error response
ee:transform.doc:description: Maps the Mule error type to the standard error body and HTTP status

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import codeFor, errorBody from dwl::ApiErrors output application/json --- errorBody(codeFor(error.errorType), vars.correlationId default correlationId, now())

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import codeFor from dwl::ApiErrors output application/java --- codeFor(error.errorType)
%dw 2.0 import codeFor, statusFor from dwl::ApiErrors output application/java --- statusFor(codeFor(error.errorType))
%dw 2.0 import qualifiedName from dwl::ApiErrors output application/java --- qualifiedName(error.errorType)

choice.doc:name: Server or client error?
choice.doc:description: Logs 5xx at ERROR and 4xx at WARN

logger.message: #['Response sent status=$(vars.httpStatus) code=$(vars.errorCode) errorType=$(vars.errorTypeName) durationMs=$((now() as Number { unit: 'milliseconds' }) - (vars.requestStartMillis default 0))']
logger.doc:name: Log server error
logger.doc:description: Logs status, error code and Mule error type of a failed request

otherwise.doc:description: Request rejected by validation or a business condition

logger.message: #['Response sent status=$(vars.httpStatus) code=$(vars.errorCode) errorType=$(vars.errorTypeName) durationMs=$((now() as Number { unit: 'milliseconds' }) - (vars.requestStartMillis default 0))']
logger.doc:name: Log client error
logger.doc:description: Logs status, error code and Mule error type of a rejected request
